McDonald’s for my family of three was $29.35 the other day. Not that bad but we then spent $50 at Five Guys.
I also got one Sun Chips, a turkey 6 inch sub, a pizza sub, and 3 cookies at Subway. It was customer appreciation, so one free cookie per sub, so we would be charged for one cookie, but we got charged for two. Guess what. It cost us TWENTY THREE DOLLARS for two subs, Sun chips, and two cookies (basically).
